- assignment.basis is PlacementBasis.Ambiguous
- address masses equal the independently recomputed formula 0.4 Unresolved / 0.3 target / 0.3 other

Near-misses are different bases, not Ambiguous:
- stay (walked around Montreal) -> ContinuityStay
- return (waiter brought a cake) -> ContinuityReturn
- unattached (dog barked) -> Unattached

Uncommitted reserved work in the shared tree. Will not land on main. Candidate SHA after I cut a branch/clone, not before.
